examples.name: Runtime · DataDisplay 与 PillButton
examples.note: DataDisplay 与 PillButton 均由共享视觉 Recipe 展开。

examples.name: Runtime · 双 InfoBlock
examples.note: 同时覆盖带图标、无图标和容器点击。
examples.source:
["root","Column",{"width":"matchParent","height":"matchParent","padding":8,"borderRadius":20,"backgroundColor":"#FFF1F6FE","itemMargin":8},["phone","earphone"]]
["phone","InfoBlock",{"primaryText":"手机 68%","secondaryText":"正常电量","fontColor":"#FF1F4799","backgroundColor":"#CCFFFFFF","icon":"resources/base/media/phone_fill.svg","fillColor":"#FF1F4799","onClick":[{"call":"clickToDeeplink","args":{"uri":"battery"}}]}]
["earphone","InfoBlock",{"primaryText":"耳机盒 90%","secondaryText":"已连接","fontColor":"#FF1F4799","backgroundColor":"#CCFFFFFF"}]

examples.name: Runtime · EventCard
examples.note: EventCard 替代旧 TimelineUnit，并保留底部动作。
examples.source:
["root","Column",{"width":"matchParent","height":"matchParent","padding":12,"borderRadius":20,"backgroundColor":"#FFFFF7F2","itemMargin":4},["header","event","action"]]
["header","CardHeader",{"title":"下一场会议","fontColor":"#FF8C4B1C"}]
["event","EventCard",{"title":"产品评审会议","time":"今天 14:30","location":"A3 会议室","fontColor":"#FF8C4B1C"}]
["action","PillButton",{"label":"加入会议","actionSurface":"#338C4B1C","actionInk":"#FF8C4B1C","onClick":[{"call":"clickToDeeplink","args":{"uri":"meeting://join"}}]}]

examples.name: Runtime · TableText 与 CircleButton
examples.note: 覆盖三行 TableText 和 36vp CircleButton。
examples.source:
["root","Column",{"width":"matchParent","height":"matchParent","padding":12,"borderRadius":20,"backgroundColor":"#FFF1F6FE","itemMargin":4},["header","table","actionRow"]]
["header","CardHeader",{"title":"明日健康指数","fontColor":"#FF1F4799"}]
["table","TableText",{"items":[{"label":"紫外线","value":"中等"},{"label":"空气质量","value":"良"},{"label":"感冒指数","value":"低"}],"fontColor":"#FF1F4799"}]
["actionRow","Row",{"width":126,"height":36,"justifyContent":"end"},["settings"]]
["settings","CircleButton",{"icon":"resources/base/media/ic_Bluetooth.svg","accessibility":{"label":"打开蓝牙设置"},"actionSurface":"#331F4799","actionInk":"#FF1F4799","onClick":[{"call":"clickToDeeplink","args":{"uri":"bluetooth_entry"}}]}]

examples.name: Runtime · EmphasizedData
examples.note: 核心值与单位的基线、字号和间距来自共享 Recipe。

examples.name: Runtime · ProgressLine2 与 TextBlock
examples.note: 覆盖线性进度与两个详情背板。
examples.source:
["root","Column",{"width":"matchParent","height":"matchParent","padding":12,"borderRadius":20,"backgroundColor":"#FFF6F2FF","itemMargin":4},["header","body"]]
["header","CardHeader",{"title":"睡眠恢复度","fontColor":"#FF563D99"}]
["body","Column",{"width":276,"height":102,"itemMargin":4},["progress","details"]]
["progress","ProgressLine2",{"value":82,"total":100,"displayValue":82,"unit":"分","fontColor":"#FF563D99","color":"#FF563D99","backgroundColor":"#33563D99"}]
["details","TextBlock",{"items":[{"label":"睡眠时长","value":"7小时1分"},{"label":"深睡时长","value":"2小时15分"}],"fontColor":"#FF563D99","backgroundColor":"#99FFFFFF"}]

examples.name: Runtime · ProgressCircleSingle
examples.note: 环形进度、环心图标与右侧读数均来自共享 Recipe。

examples.name: Runtime · CardButton
examples.note: 同时覆盖图标视觉位和无图标占位视觉。
examples.source:
["root","Column",{"width":"matchParent","height":"matchParent","padding":12,"borderRadius":20,"backgroundColor":"#FFFFF7F2","itemMargin":12},["header","actions"]]
["header","CardHeader",{"title":"快捷操作","fontColor":"#FF8C4B1C"}]
["actions","Row",{"width":276,"height":57,"itemMargin":12},["calendar","focus"]]
["calendar","CardButton",{"label":"查看日程","icon":"resources/base/media/calendar_fill.svg","fillColor":"#FF8C4B1C","fontColor":"#FF8C4B1C","backgroundColor":"#99FFFFFF","onClick":[{"call":"clickToIntent","args":{"intentName":"Calendar"}}]}]
["focus","CardButton",{"label":"专注模式","fontColor":"#FF8C4B1C","backgroundColor":"#99FFFFFF","onClick":[{"call":"clickToDeeplink","args":{"uri":"focus"}}]}]

examples.name: Runtime · TopTextBottomValue
examples.note: 三项同级指标与两个分隔线由组件展开。
examples.source:
["root","Column",{"width":"matchParent","height":"matchParent","padding":12,"borderRadius":20,"backgroundColor":"#FFF6F2FF","itemMargin":12},["header","metrics"]]
["header","CardHeader",{"title":"我的健康数据","fontColor":"#FF563D99"}]
["metrics","TopTextBottomValue",{"items":[{"label":"睡眠得分","value":80,"unit":"分"},{"label":"消耗热量","value":92,"unit":"千卡"},{"label":"今日步数","value":2031,"unit":"步"}],"fontColor":"#FF563D99","dividerColor":"#33563D99"}]

examples.name: Runtime · SummaryList
examples.note: SummaryList 使用与云侧转换器一致的原生固定三行展开。
examples.source:
["root","Column",{"width":"matchParent","height":"matchParent","padding":12,"borderRadius":20,"backgroundColor":"#FFFFF7F2","itemMargin":4},["header","list"]]
["header","CardHeader",{"title":"近期日程","fontColor":"#FF8C4B1C"}]
["list","SummaryList",{"items":["项目阶段性汇报","确认 Q3 设计需求","申请下周出差"],"fontColor":"#FF8C4B1C","backgroundColor":"#99FFFFFF"}]
